story.title: A holiday race morning that moves a mobile mission forward.
paragraphs: A Worthy Clause brings runners and walkers to Riverside in Columbia for a holiday-themed 5K and 1-mile fun run/walk. Christmas attire is encouraged, with the day framed around community connection, movement, music, and mindfulness.
The race supports A Worthy Cause’s A Worthy Movement initiative — a bus designed to bring nutrition education, movement, and mindfulness directly to communities and youth.
Food trucks, health vendors, and a DJ are listed after the race, so participants are encouraged to stay after they finish and be with the community.
story.quote: Your registration makes a real impact— All proceeds go directly toward bringing our mobile mission to life and help reach, teach and inspire.
